version.changelog: v2.5 standard: Use-when desc, homepage, source, security fix

llm.summary: The skill includes a normal slogan generator, but it also ships an unrelated data-tool command that creates local storage and logs user arguments without clear disclosure.

dimensions.detail: The unrelated script creates a user data directory under SLOGAN_MAKER_DIR, XDG_DATA_HOME, or ~/.local/share/slogan-maker, which is not proportionate to the documented slogan-generation purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or install hook was observed; however the effective command entry point is ambiguous because both a slogan script and an unrelated slogan-maker script are packaged.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The documented runtime instruction says to run slogan-maker help, while scripts/script.sh uses that command name for unrelated data commands instead of the advertised slogan workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No privilege escalation, startup persistence, network exfiltration, or destructive behavior was found, but scripts/script.sh persists command history arguments in plaintext history.log without documented consent, retention, or permission hardening.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md describes slogan generation, translation, testing, and slogan collections; scripts/slogan.sh matches that purpose, but scripts/script.sh presents a separate data processing toolkit with query/import/export/transform/dashboard commands.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. The slogan generator itself is local and purpose-aligned, but the package also includes an unrelated data-processing command that writes local history. Avoid entering sensitive campaign text, customer identifiers, file paths, or private queries unless the publisher removes or clearly documents that script and its logging behavior.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Accepted in part: artifact evidence confirms a declared slogan-maker purpose alongside an unrelated data-processing script using the slogan-maker command name.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: scripts/script.sh contains data-oriented commands that do not fit the advertised slogan-generation capability.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the script banner and help text explicitly describe a data processing and analysis toolkit, conflicting with the manifest purpose.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-language interface is visible in SKILL.md and fits a Chinese-localized slogan tool, though users should know the workflow is mostly Chinese.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted: scripts/script.sh appends command names and first arguments to a persistent plaintext history.log, which is not disclosed in the slogan-maker documentation.
